# Isamelo Real Estate Dubai

> Find your ideal Dubai property in 60 seconds. Answer 8 quick questions and receive a hand-picked shortlist on WhatsApp, with payment plans, full costs and Golden Visa guidance included.

## About

Isamelo Real Estate is a RERA-certified Dubai brokerage helping buyers and investors find off-plan and ready properties in Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah. The site is available in English, Portuguese and Spanish, and replies to new leads within the hour.

## Key facts

- 0% annual property tax on Dubai property, with no tax on rental income for individuals
- 5-8% typical gross rental yield in established communities, ahead of London, Singapore and Hong Kong
- AED 2,000,000 property threshold for the renewable 10-year Golden Visa
- Foreign nationals can own freehold property in designated communities such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah
- Budget around 4% Dubai Land Department (DLD) transfer fee and about 2% agency commission on top of the purchase price
- Off-plan launches commonly offer 60/40 or 50/50 payment plans spread across construction milestones

## How the service works

1. The visitor answers 8 short questions covering intent (buy, invest or sell), timeline, budget, payment method, the main goal for the property, and nationality.
2. Isamelo matches the answers against live stock, both ready units and off-plan launches, filtered by budget and reason for buying.
3. A hand-picked shortlist is delivered on WhatsApp within the hour, including floor plans, payment schedules, service charges and every transfer cost.

## Buying guide topics covered on the page

- Cost breakdown for buying property in Dubai (DLD fee, agency commission, registration fee, tax treatment)
- Off-plan vs ready property decision factors (payment plans, rental income timing, mortgage eligibility, Golden Visa timing)
- Golden Visa eligibility and the AED 2M property threshold
- Rental yield expectations by community and property type

## Frequently asked questions

- What does it cost to buy property in Dubai? Allow around 4% for the DLD fee and about 2% for agency fees, on top of the purchase price. There is no annual property tax and no tax on rental income for individuals.
- Can foreigners buy property in Dubai? Yes, in designated freehold communities such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah.
- What budget qualifies for the Golden Visa? AED 2M or more in property value can qualify the owner and immediate family for the 10-year UAE residency visa.
- Do you cover off-plan and ready properties? Yes, both are included depending on the buyer's goal and timeline.
- How do I receive my property shortlist? Answer the 8-question form at https://find.isamelorealestate.com and the shortlist arrives on WhatsApp within the hour.
- Are rental yields in Dubai still attractive? Established communities typically deliver 5-8% gross rental yield.

- UAE Government Portal: https://u.ae/en/
